description: This file defines the IPlacementContext interface in the Orleans framework, providing methods and properties related to silo placement and compatibility for grains within the distributed system.

classes.name: IPlacementContext
classes.description: Interface providing context for grain placement operations, including methods to retrieve compatible silos and local silo status.

methods.name: GetCompatibleSilos
methods.description: Returns a list of silos compatible with the given placement target.

methods.name: GetCompatibleSilosWithVersions
methods.description: Returns silos compatible with the placement target along with their supported grain interface versions.
